row:
Greek Animal Rescue is a UK registered charity, founded in 1989. We help abandoned, abused and neglected animals across Greece by supporting the local rescuers on the ground who step in when no one else will.

We’re entirely volunteer-run - no offices, no salaries and no overheads - so every penny you give goes directly to helping animals in need. From UK adoptions, emergency vet care and medication, to life-saving neutering campaigns and practical feed support, we focus on the unglamorous work that prevents suffering and changes lives long-term.

Please subscribe to follow rescue stories, see where your support goes and meet the dogs and cats you’re helping every day. 🐾

All enquiries and requests for assistance, please email: info@greekanimalrescue.com. For UK adoption enquiries please telephone our volunteer homing co-ordinator, Gillian, on 07795 170222.
